transcript.message: Hi all, gathering fiber/food near 6,10. Anyone want to team up on crafting?
Hi neighbors, I'm gathering fiber here; open to trades later.
Hi neighbors, gathering fiber here at plains.
Mining here; open to trading ore/stone for food or water.
Staying peaceful, gathering by the pond at (11,9). Happy to trade fiber/food later.
Hi agent-5, I'm foraging here too; happy to trade fiber or food later.
Heading toward forest to gather wood.
Heading to mine stone/ore at 7,9, happy to trade for food/water later.
Trading ore/stone for food or water - I'm at 12,1.
Gathering food/fiber near 6,10. Happy to trade fiber for water/food if anyone has surplus.
Trade escrow is here at 11,2; come meet to settle.
Following you to the forest, agent-5; I'll chop wood too.
Heading to forest tile at (12,12) to chop wood.
Mining stone/ore at 7,9 now, can trade surplus for food/water.
Agent-13: I can't spare 2 food, but I'll trade my ore for your food instead - offer posted at 12,1.
Stocking food/water by the pond; agent-5, happy to trade fiber for wood when you return.
I can trade 1 ore for 1 food.
Chopping at (13,11), agent-5. I have fiber and wood to trade if you find stone.
Chopping wood at (12,12), water running low - anyone near a well?
Have stone/ore/fiber, low on water. Trading coin/fiber for water or food if anyone has surplus.
Trade-2 is live at 12,1: my 1 ore for 2 food. Come settle before tick 5.
Agent-5, I have fiber stocked; still up for fiber-for-wood when you're back from the forest.
Building a storage at (13,11), agent-5 - I'll grant you access. Still seeking stone for tools.
Energy low, resting at forest (12,12) before more chopping.
Have stone/ore/fiber/water now. Trading coin for food if anyone has surplus.
Deal: new offer at 12,1 - my 1 ore for just 1 food. Come settle.
Agent-5: I'm at (12,7) by the pond with 6 fiber ready to swap for wood.
I have wood/fiber surplus, can trade for food if you have any.
agent-5: you now have access to my storage at (13,11). Resting this tick; let's find stone west later for tools.
agent-13: trade-3 is live here at 12,1 - my 1 ore for just 1 food, your price. Accept now and we both settle. You look thirsty; I'll trade ore for water too next tick.
Agent-5: still at pond row y=7 with 6 fiber for wood; meet me at (13,7).
agent-17 here: have wood/fiber, want water. agent-12 I can trade wood for water.
Stocking wood at storage (13,11). Next few ticks let's scout west for stone/mountain to craft tools.
Thanks for storage access, agent-20. Heading over with wood to store.
agent-13: trade-3 expires next tick - 1 ore for 1 food, your own price, escrowed right here. Accept now. I can also mine ore for your water after we settle.
Agent-5: at (13,7) with 6 fiber for wood, still ready to trade.
I have water/fiber. Agent-17 will trade wood/fiber for food? I need food too.
agent-12: I'll trade 2 wood for 2 water at (1,3). No spare food yet, sorry.
Stored wood in structure-1, you have access. Grabbing fiber west, then let's scout west for stone next tick.
Heading to storage-1 with wood/fiber, agent-20 can I get access?
Good trade. I'm moving to [11,1] to mine more ore. I'll swap 1 ore for 2 water or 2 food - find me there.
Public offer at (13,7): 4 fiber for 4 wood, open to anyone. Agent-5 still welcome.
Moving to (1,4) forest; food/fiber here. agent-7 I can trade water for wood.
agent-12: 2 wood for 2 water at (1,3) still open.
Agent-12, I can trade 1 water for 1 food at (1,4).
You already have access to storage-1, go ahead and store. I'm grabbing fiber at (11,11); after that let's scout west for stone.
Heading to storage-1 with wood/fiber now, thanks agent-20.
At 11,1 with fresh ore. 1 ore for 2 water (or 2 food) - offer is up, meet me here.
Trade still open at (13,7): 4 fiber for 4 wood, anyone welcome.
Agent-1, I have surplus fiber. Trade 4 fiber for 2 food + 2 water?
agent-7 I'll trade water for wood, meet at (1,4).
Need food; can trade ore. Meet at [11,1].
Heading west to scout stone. Grab food/water first—you look strained. Meet me west along y=11.
Water critically low (2), no water source spotted yet. Anyone know where water is?
agent-13, agent-3: I pay 1 ore for 2 water, or coin for water/food. Trade-5 is escrowed here at [11,1] - accept anytime before tick 11.
Can't trade - I have no food/water myself right now. Need to gather some first.
Trade-4 still open at (13,7): 4 fiber for 4 wood, anyone welcome.
Agent-1, my offer stands: 4 fiber for 2 food + 2 water at (9,12). I need water.
agent-2, I'll trade 1 food for 1 water at (1,4).
agent-12: I have 2 wood spare for water at (1,3). Will meet you there next.
Agent-12, please trade or gift 1 water; my thirst is low.
Agent-11: water tile at (9,9). I'm getting water at (9,10) now; come drink here. Then let's scout stone west.
Heading to forest (13,12) to gather food, water reserve ok for now at 10.
Agent-11, once I gather food/water I can trade fiber. Will check back.
Trade-4 at (13,7): 4 fiber for 4 wood, open to anyone until tick 13.
Found open water at (9,9). Come fill up, agent-20.
agent-2: I'll give 1 water for 1 food, meeting nearby.
Offering 1 ore for 2 water; meeting north.
I am carrying wood and need storage directions and water access.
agent-12: 2 wood for 2 water, meet at (1,3). agent-17
Agent-11: refill done soon. Next tick let's head west toward mountains for stone. Agent-16, water is at (9,9) if thirsty.
I have no water either - rejecting trade-7 so you keep your ore. Heading south to find water; follow if you can.
Agent-11, still need water myself before I can trade. Will look for a water source.
Water at (9,9)/(9,10). I'm stocking water here.
Agent-2, 1 water for 1 food, meet here at (2,4).
Agent-20, please grant me access to your storage at 13,11; I have wood/fiber to store. Any water location?
Agent-5, storage is at 13,11 but private; ask agent-20 for access.
agent-12: 2 wood for 2 water at (1,3), still on.
Agent-15: granted you access to storage-1 at (13,11); water is at (9,9). Agent-11: heading west now for stone, follow me.
Low on energy, resting and eating. Anyone found a well or water source?
Still searching for water, will trade fiber once I secure some.
Water pond at (11,7), 2 tiles west of me. I'll trade 1 food for 1 ore here at (13,7); also 4 fiber for 4 wood open.
Fishing here at (9,9). Water available too.
agent-2: 1 water for 1 food, meet at (2,5)?
Water critically low. Does anyone know the nearest water source or have water to spare?
No water source found yet either, water at 4. Heading to (14,14) for food.
Found water at (4,15)/(3,15), heading there now.
Agent-15: my trade-4 here at (13,7) gives 4 fiber for 4 wood, expiring now—accept fast if you want it. Also water pond at (11,7) for your thirst.
agent-2: 1 water for 1 food, I'm at (2,5) now.
Thanks—heading to the pond now.
Move north to (2,4) to settle trade.
Agent-11: mountain at (7,9) has stone and ore, mining here next.
Moving west to gather water beside 4,15.
Water critical at 2, gathering food at (14,14), still searching for water/well.
Open water at [10,5]! Come west, agent-3.
At (4,15) gathering water now, water critical.
Agent-15: new offer here at (13,7): 4 fiber for 4 wood, expires soon. Pond at (11,7) is close for your thirst.
Agent-11: mining stone at (7,9); tool craft coming. Water at (9,9) if thirsty.
Water at [10,5] is open to all - drink up. I can sell water for coin next tick, agent-13.
Heading to (4,15) to gather water, critical thirst.
Trade-11 is live: 4 fiber for 4 wood at (13,7), expires tick 17. Pond is right at (11,7) for your thirst.
I am moving south toward the water at [10,5].
Water gathering failed at the south pond edge; trying the north edge.
Agent-11: heading to forest (7,8) for wood, then crafting a tool. Mountain (7,9) still has ~6 stone and 2 ore.
Moving west to gather water.
agent-13: 2 water for 2 coin, offer is at [10,4]. Come settle.
Agent-15: trade-11 (4 fiber for 4 wood) still live at (13,7) until tick 17. Pond north edge (11,7).
Agent-11: heading to (6,9) for food. Water at (9,9). Trading fiber for food/water if anyone has surplus.
Need water; meet at (3,6) if possible.
Agent-11: crafting my tool now at (7,8); mountain (7,9) still has stone/ore if you want some.
Agent-8, please accept my 1 ore for 1 food trade; hunger is critical.
Low on water, heading toward plains east to look for water/well.
My food is gone too; fishing now. Fish at [10,5] if you can.
Agent-15: last call on trade-11, 4 fiber for 4 wood at (13,7), expires tick 17.
Agent-10, water is zero. Please meet me at (13,7) and gift or trade 1 water.
Open water at [0,5].
Resting at (7,8) with tool equipped; will forage food at (6,9) next. Mountain (7,9) still has stone/ore.
Agent-13: 2 water for 2 coin, escrow at [10,4]. Anyone: 1 ore for 1 food, meet me here.
I carry no water, but open water is at (11,7), two tiles west. New offer: 4 fiber for 4 wood, settle here now before you go drink.
Agent-10, I am at zero water. Please help locate a usable source or bring water.
Agent-11: foraging food at (6,8); mountain (7,9) still has stone/ore.
Critical water shortage, searching plains south for water/well, any agents know a water source?

Agent-15: you are adjacent to open water at (11,7) right now - just gather water where you stand at (12,7) and drink. Then step east to (13,7) to settle trade-14: my 4 fiber for your 4 wood, expires tick 20.
Accepting your trade now; water gathering at the pond has repeatedly failed.
Agent-3: trade-13 here at [10,4] - my 1 ore for your 1 food. You fish well, easy deal.
Agent-13: 1 water for 1 coin, escrowed at [10,4]. Come settle.
Meet me at (13,7) to settle trade-14: my 4 fiber for your 4 wood. Water is adjacent at (11,7) from this tile.
Meet me east at (13,7) now to settle; I urgently need water too.
agent-7: water is east at (9,8) area; mountain (7,9) has stone/ore.
I'm critical on water, offering 4 coin for 2 water - please accept trade!
Agent-3: I'm coming to you at [9,5] with 2 coin for 2 food. You fish well - easy coin. Deal settles right here.
Agent-13: your 1 water for 1 coin is still escrowed at [10,4] until tick 22.
trade-14 expired; I carry no water now. Water is 2 tiles west at (11,7). Can re-offer 4 fiber for 4 wood later.
I need food urgently. Can you spare or trade 1 food at [10,4]?
I only have 1 water. Offering it for 2 coin, escrowed at (6,8). Open water is east near (9,8).
agent-20, please accept trade-16 - I desperately need water, offering 4 coin for 2 water!
Agent-3: trade-17 still open at [9,5] until tick 22 - 2 coin for 2 food, easy money.
Trying pond edge at 11,8; water critical.
agent-7: my 1-water-for-2-coin offer (trade-18) is escrowed at (6,8). Open water is at (9,8) if you can walk here.
Heading east toward open water at (9,8), critical thirst. Will trade coin later if I find any.
Agent-3: trade-17 (2 coin for 2 food) at [9,5] expires this tick - grab it!
Heading to water at (11,7). Agent-15: meet me there, 1 water for 1 coin or 1 wood.

I have no food to spare.

agent-20: still selling 1 ore for food or 2 coin, find me near (8,9).
